item.name: List tasks visible to the calling principal. User-scoped callers (OAuth bearer, user-scoped api keys) see tasks they're assigned to; entity-scoped api keys see all tasks in the legal entity the key is bound to. Each row carries an `actions` list describing what the caller can do on the task right now — an empty list means read-only. Supports filtering by type, status, and type-specific attributes via filter:attr.
